folded.id: then he|produces|thereby crops of varying colors
folded.subject: then He

spans.text: [21] AR: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَسَلَكَهُۥ يَنَٰبِيعَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُ بِهِۦ زَرْعًۭا مُّخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَٰنُهُۥ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَىٰهُ مُصْفَرًّۭا ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُۥ حُطَٰمًا ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ EN: Do you not see that Allah sends down rain from the sky and makes it flow as springs [and rivers] in the earth; then He produces thereby crops of varying colors; then they dry and you see them turned yellow; then He makes them [scattered] debris.

folded.id: there|is|no deity except him
folded.subject: There

spans.text: There is no deity except Him, so how are you averted?

folded.id: they will|have|canopies of fire above them and below them
folded.subject: They will
folded.object: canopies of fire above them and below them

spans.text: [16] AR: لَهُم مِّن فَوْقِهِمْ ظُلَلٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ وَمِن تَحْتِهِمْ ظُلَلٌۭ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يُخَوِّفُ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦ عِبَادَهُۥ ۚ يَٰعِبَادِ فَٱتَّقُونِ EN: They will have canopies of fire above them and below them, canopies.

folded.id: those who|do|good in this world is good
folded.subject: those who
folded.object: good in this world is good

spans.text: For those who do good in this world is good, and the earth of Allah is spacious.

folded.id: those who|do|not know?"
folded.subject: those who

spans.text: Say, "Are those who know equal to those who do not know?"

folded.id: those who|have|avoided taghut
folded.subject: those who

spans.text: [17] AR: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱجْتَنَبُوا۟ ٱلطَّٰغُوتَ أَن يَعْبُدُوهَا وَأَنَابُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ لَهُمُ ٱلْبُشْرَىٰ ۚ فَبَشِّرْ عِبَادِ EN: But those who have avoided Taghut, lest they worship it, and turned back to Allah - for them are good tidings.

folded.id: those who|have|feared their lord - for them are chambers
folded.subject: those who
folded.object: feared their Lord - for them are chambers

spans.text: [20] AR: لَٰكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ غُرَفٌۭ مِّن فَوْقِهَا غُرَفٌۭ مَّبْنِيَّةٌۭ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۖ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ لَا يُخْلِفُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمِيعَادَ EN: But those who have feared their Lord - for them are chambers, above them chambers built high, beneath which rivers flow.

folded.id: to allah|equals|to mislead [people] from his way
folded.subject: to Allah

spans.text: [8] AR: ۞ وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ ضُرٌّۭ دَعَا رَبَّهُۥ مُنِيبًا إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلَهُۥ نِعْمَةًۭ مِّنْهُ نَسِىَ مَا كَانَ يَدْعُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ مِن قَبْلُ وَجَعَلَ لِلَّهِ أَندَادًۭا لِّيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ ۚ قُلْ تَمَتَّعْ بِكُفْرِكَ قَلِيلًا ۖ إِنَّكَ مِنْ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلنَّارِ EN: And when adversity touches man, he calls upon his Lord, turning to Him [alone]; then when He bestows on him a favor from Himself, he forgets Him whom he called upon before, and he attributes to Allah equals to mislead [people] from His way.

folded.id: to him|belongs|dominion
folded.subject: to Him

spans.text: That is Allah, your Lord; to Him belongs dominion.

folded.id: we|have|sent down to you the book
folded.subject: We
folded.object: sent down to you the Book

spans.text: [2] AR: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَٱعْبُدِ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصًۭا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ EN: Indeed, We have sent down to you the Book, [O Muhammad], in truth.

folded.id: what you|will|besides him
folded.subject: what you

spans.text: [15] AR: فَٱعْبُدُوا۟ مَا شِئْتُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ ۗ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَأَهْلِيهِمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۗ أَلَا ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْخُسْرَانُ ٱلْمُبِينُ EN: So worship what you will besides Him."

folded.id: when he|bestows|on him a favor from himself
folded.subject: when He
folded.object: on him a favor from Himself

spans.text: [8] AR: ۞ وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ ضُرٌّۭ دَعَا رَبَّهُۥ مُنِيبًا إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلَهُۥ نِعْمَةًۭ مِّنْهُ نَسِىَ مَا كَانَ يَدْعُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ مِن قَبْلُ وَجَعَلَ لِلَّهِ أَندَادًۭا لِّيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ ۚ قُلْ تَمَتَّعْ بِكُفْرِكَ قَلِيلًا ۖ إِنَّكَ مِنْ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلنَّارِ EN: And when adversity touches man, he calls upon his Lord, turning to Him [alone]; then when He bestows on him a favor from Himself, he forgets Him whom he called upon before, and he attributes to Allah equals to mislead [people] from His way.

folded.id: your lord|is|your return
folded.subject: your Lord

spans.text: Then to your Lord is your return, and He will inform you about what you used to do.
